tldr: Websites are increasingly blocking AI agents, making dependable access to real-world services a design constraint for agent workflows.
Replit says OpenAI will replace Anthropic as its default model provider, though Claude remains available to customers.

top.title: Websites are increasingly blocking AI agents
top.summary: As companies promote agents that browse and act online, more websites are restricting agent access. That creates friction for agents expected to handle tasks such as shopping, bookings, and email.
top.why: When designing agents that depend on the public web, plan for blocked or unreliable access and provide supported API integrations or a human fallback.

also.title: Replit makes OpenAI its default model provider, while keeping Claude available
also.summary: Replit CEO Amjad Masad said OpenAI will replace Anthropic as the platform’s default model provider, while Claude will remain available to customers.

also.title: InBox Wall sanitizes email before AI agents process it
also.summary: This open-source, local-first MCP server sanitizes email HTML to guard agents against hidden CSS and Unicode prompt injections before the content reaches an LLM.
